reasons: The cited Section 15.1 is a genuine vendor-side indemnity running to IBM (our party), expressly covering third-party IP infringement (patent, trademark, copyright, mask work, trade secret), MSL's failure to comply with law, and failure to perform warranty/support obligations — squarely at or above the fallback position.

Carve-outs (IBM-selected marks, MSL's compliance with IBM's written specifications, defects from IBM-supplied designs) are the customary exclusions contemplated by the fallback, and p0265/p0271 supply standard procedure and the procure-licence/redesign remedy.
No broad reciprocal customer indemnity for the vendor's services was identified, so the walk-away scenario does not apply.
Consistent with the claimed compliant status, no redline or counterparty comment was proposed, and the deterministic check confirming a vendor IP indemnity passes.

Shortfalls versus preferred wording (no affiliate extension, no separate data-breach or gross-negligence limbs, no refund remedy) are correctly noted in the rationale rather than raised as a deviation, and the 3%-of-BOM cap is properly deferred to the limitation-of-liability rule to avoid double-flagging.
